This comic is a direct continuation of the story told in "Two Problems at Once" comic https://e-hentai.org/g/1552589/70f6bf6dd8/
Since there were two people lying in the trunk at the end of the comic, the stories of each are told separately. This is the story of a black panther named Matt.
You can find out what happened to his buddy named Oleg here - https://e-hentai.org/g/2096506/f463e443ca/

Don't forget that you can support the artist and the creation of this and other comics - https://www.patreon.com/eliana
